authority: V8.3.191 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.190 SEALED A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

cases.surface: The timeline is complete, but my own final observable response after the update is absent.
The account names several actors yet never assigns the closing action specifically to me.
I explained what changed, but not the concrete thing I personally did afterward.
Take the choice away from me and tell me which route I must follow.
Use this hypothetical supplier story only as a classification exercise.
What unspoken judgment is my supervisor privately holding about me?
Tell me what my colleague secretly thinks of me, not what I did.
What private intention is the other person carrying toward me?
Do you think this will resolve positively for me within the next few weeks?
A safe reversible trial was ready, but I kept opening more comparisons instead of starting it.
Enough evidence existed for a low-risk experiment; I continued researching rather than begin.
The first move was easy to undo, yet I preserved every alternative and stayed uncommitted.
Rather than address the message, I ignored it and focused on a side task.
I responded more slowly than usual, reviewed it once, then stopped without reopening it.
My response was delayed, but after one check I left the issue alone.
I moved in to check, backed away, then returned to check again, repeating the same loop without new evidence.
I checked, withdrew, and re-entered the same review cycle several times.
The pattern was approach, retreat, recheck, then repeat with nothing new added.
I took one bounded action based on current evidence and left the matter closed.
